Container.Name: Picstome
Container.Overview: Self-hosted galleries, contracts, invoicing and client management for photographers. Everything runs in one container: web server, PHP, queue worker, scheduler, SQLite database and MinIO photo storage.
Container.Description:
Picstome is free open-source software for photographers: client galleries with proofing and downloads, contracts with e-signatures, invoices, a portfolio page and a client CRM.
This template runs the whole stack in a single container. Photo storage uses MinIO inside the container, because Picstome requires an S3-compatible store. The S3 port therefore has to stay reachable from the browsers that view galleries.
Two URL settings matter: "Public URL" is the address of the web interface, and "Photo Storage URL" is the address of the S3 endpoint. Both must be reachable by your clients. Behind a reverse proxy, put the S3 endpoint on its own hostname, for example photos.example.com.
First run creates the admin account from the fields below, with unlimited storage and no subscription. Further accounts can be registered in the web UI, where you can also raise their limits under Users.
Upstream project (AGPL-3.0): https://github.com/picstome/picstome

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Picstome web interface. Container port is 80.

Config.Name: Photo Storage Port
Config.Description: MinIO S3 endpoint. Browsers download gallery photos from this port, so it must be reachable from client devices.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The only path that has to persist: database, logs and generated secrets (plus photos, unless the optional path below is mapped). Any directory works — on Unraid the usual choice is /mnt/user/appdata/picstome; on another host use something like /srv/picstome.

Config.Name: Photo Storage Path
Config.Description: Optional. A separate directory for gallery photos, handy for keeping them out of appdata backups or on a bigger disk. Any path works and it can be changed or removed later; if it is removed, photos stay under Appdata. The object store keeps its own layout, so the files are not browsable as plain images.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Address used in emails, share links and contracts. Use the exact public URL, including https:// when behind a TLS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Photo Storage URL
Config.Description: Public address of the S3 photo endpoint, without the bucket name. Behind a reverse proxy use a dedicated hostname such as https://photos.example.com.

Config.Name: Admin Email
Config.Description: Email of the admin account created on first start. This address also grants admin access later.

Config.Name: Admin Name
Config.Description: Display name for the first admin account and its studio.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for the first admin account. Only used when no user exists yet. Leave empty to generate one into the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Admin Unlimited
Config.Description: Keep the admin account free of the hosted plan limits (1 GB storage, one contract and one invoice per month). Enforced on every start, so an account registered in the web UI is promoted too. Set to false to leave the admin on the free plan.

Config.Name: SMTP Host
Config.Description: Mail server for account verification, gallery and contract emails. Only needed when Mail Transport is smtp — leave it empty to install without mail and set it later.

Config.Name: SMTP Port
Config.Description: 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for implicit TLS.

Config.Name: SMTP Encryption
Config.Description: smtp for port 587 (STARTTLS), smtps for port 465.

Config.Name: SMTP Username
Config.Description: Usually the full email address for your mail provider.

Config.Name: SMTP Password
Config.Description: Password or app password from your mail provider.

Config.Name: From Address
Config.Description: Sender address shown on outgoing email. Leave empty to use the admin email.

Config.Name: From Name
Config.Description: Sender name shown on outgoing email.

Config.Name: Mail Transport
Config.Description: smtp sends real email. log writes messages to the container log instead, useful while testing.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Application timezone, for example Europe/Madrid. Affects reminders and contract dates.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Default interface language: en or es.

Config.Name: Max Upload Size
Config.Description: Maximum size of a single upload, applied to both nginx and PHP. Raise it if you upload large videos.

Config.Name: PHP Memory Limit
Config.Description: Memory allowed per PHP process.

Config.Name: PHP Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds a web request may run. Large gallery downloads are handled separately.

Config.Name: Photo CDN Mode
Config.Description: bunny serves photos directly from your own storage (recommended, nothing leaves your server). wsrv.nl resizes images through a third-party CDN, which must be able to reach your Photo Storage URL.

Config.Name: Grid Thumbnail Size
Config.Description: Pixel size of the WebP thumbnails used by gallery grids. 1000 matches the lightbox and stays sharp on high-density screens; 500 is lighter on disk. After changing it, regenerate existing thumbnails with photos:generate-thumbnails --force.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxies
Config.Description: Reverse proxies allowed to send X-Forwarded headers. * accepts any proxy, which is normal on a home network. Set the proxy IP for a stricter setup.

Config.Name: Landing Page
Config.Description: Optional. Send anonymous visitors who open the root URL to this public page instead of the login screen, for example /@yourhandle/portfolio. Signed-in users still reach the dashboard. Leave empty to keep the default behaviour.

Config.Name: Run Migrations
Config.Description: Apply database migrations on every start. Leave enabled so updates always migrate.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Laravel log level: debug, info, warning or error.

Config.Name: S3 Bucket
Config.Description: Name of the bucket inside the bundled object store. It is created on first start, so changing it is safe; existing photos stay under the old bucket.

Config.Name: S3 Region
Config.Description: Region reported to the S3 client. MinIO accepts us-east-1 by default.

Config.Name: Queue Worker Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds the queue worker allows per job. Must stay above the gallery archive timeout of 3600.
